cards.answer: Urgot is a fighter and tank with an AD damage focus and physical shotgun blasts. He uses sustained fire and a shielded dash to pressure enemies, then threatens low-health targets with an execute.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance during sustained fire, sidestep his dash, and disengage before your health gets low.

cards.answer: Echoing Flames: Basic attacks and Purge trigger physical shotgun blasts. Each leg covers a different arc and has its own cooldown; its blast hits a cone and deals damage based on the target's maximum health.
cards.counterplay: Avoid circling around him during trades, which can expose you to fresh leg blasts.

cards.answer: Corrosive Charge: Urgot launches a canister at a location that explodes after a brief delay, dealing physical damage and briefly slowing enemies hit.
cards.counterplay: Move away from the targeted area and keep your distance if slowed.

facts.claim: Urgot launches a canister at a location that explodes after a brief delay, dealing physical damage and briefly slowing enemies hit.

cards.priority_reason: His ranged slow helps him approach and maintain pressure.

cards.answer: Purge: Urgot automatically fires at the nearest enemy, prioritizing champions marked by his other abilities. He can move while firing, but moves more slowly and gains slow resistance; the shots deal physical damage and trigger Echoing Flames. At maximum rank, Purge becomes an indefinite toggle.
cards.counterplay: Create distance while he fires, especially after his other abilities hit you.

cards.answer: Disdain: Urgot shields himself, then dashes in a direction, dealing physical damage and knocking aside enemies hit. He stops at an enemy champion, stunning and flinging them behind him. Neither the dash nor the fling crosses terrain.
cards.counterplay: Sidestep his approach and use terrain to limit his dash.

cards.answer: Fear Beyond Death: A chem-drill hits the first enemy champion in its path, dealing physical damage, revealing them and slowing them more as their health falls. If the target falls below the execution threshold while leashed, Urgot can recast to suppress and reel them in for execution. A successful execution fears and slows nearby enemies.
cards.counterplay: Dodge the drill, retreat early when low on health, and spread away from a victim being reeled in.
